scope: Initial resource assessment followed by PI-authorized bounded Nemotron/Mistral Nano benchmark. Isolated native runtimes and verified checkpoints are installed; automatic local-only comparison is queued. Existing scientific jobs unchanged.

nemotron.candidate: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B, official NVFP4
nemotron.observed: NVIDIA model card documents 120B total/12B active, text/image/video, configurable reasoning, OpenMDW-1.1; official HF card provides single-DGX-Spark serving recipes.
nemotron.organizational_eligibility: PI reports Nemotron Super3 models approved; subsequently says3.5SuperVL should be on the ORNL list but may not yet be listed. Agent could not access authenticated SharePoint list. No independent formal approval of3.5 is claimed; PI explicitly authorizes the bounded Nano comparison.
nemotron.approval_source: User: Nemotron Super3 models approved. Later:3.5SuperVL should also be on the list but it has not been updated. Explicit test authorization: Go ahead and use marigold and lavender to test nemotron vs mistral.
nemotron.assessment: Benchmark against frozen project regression cases plus fresh blind multimodal/chemistry cases before assigning scientific dispatch.
nemotron.older_model_provenance: Official Nemotron3Super120B model card also lists DeepSeek/Qwen synthetic datasets. This training provenance is not unique to3.5 and does not itself establish a runtime data-transmission path.

nemotron_for_science.observed: November16 announcement bundles Nemotron3.5SuperVL, LitmusBench v0.2 and adaptation recipes. Examples include task-specific post-training and a KTH GROMACS setup-repair agent with independent executable validation.
nemotron_for_science.assessment: Relevant architecture and validation pattern; no demonstrated Nyl12 mechanism expertise or TS/PMF qualification.

bionemo.observed: NIM/model catalog includes Boltz2, OpenFold3, MSA search, ProteinMPNN and RFD4-Proteina. Public BioNeMo Agent Toolkit offers instructions/scripts/evaluation patterns and native open-model skills.
bionemo.assessment: Selectively reuse model/workflow adapters; retain validated Amber/QM-MM/PyMBAR chemistry and artifact contracts. ProteinMPNN availability does not replace ligand-aware LigandMPNN.

genesis.assessment: Literature guidance useful now; Academy distributed middleware later; Slurm not needed for existing workstation tmux jobs. Delegated SKILL.md path inventory found no dedicated QM-MM/MD/pKa/enzyme-mechanism skill.

zgx_nano.observed: PI confirms both marigold/lavender GB10 with128GB; SSH and nvidia-smi verified ARM64/GB10 and about121GiB system RAM each. Both GPUs idle at benchmark preflight.
zgx_nano.ssh_verified_20261125: SSH succeeded as jpc on both hosts with existing aster key. Native ARM64/GB10 and about121GiB RAM independently verified; official CUDA13 runtime/tensor validation passed on both. See benchmark technical_acceptance.json and job receipts.
zgx_nano.assessment: Use separate local /data/jpc/projects benchmark roots, isolated native ARM64 uv/vLLM environments, and official publisher NVFP4 weights. Existing shared-home uv is x86 and Docker requires a password. No shared-home or global/system changes.
